title: Write walkthrough page content (IP-safe)
description: Draft the /daemon/walkthrough page content using one scenario (code review) with labelled stages and examples.
acceptance_criteria: Walkthrough is one scenario only (code review) and fits on a single page.
Each stage is clearly labelled and uses concise, skimmable sections.
Includes one violation example and one prompt injection example with honest V1 limitations.
Does not reveal internal confidential details; uses public-safe terms already used on site (MAX bus, templates, action protocol).
Links added from homepage and /daemon index.
